name: [🌋] ✈️ Build A Plane
desc:
✈️ Welcome to Build A Plane!

Design your very own plane, dodge a variety of crazy obstacles, and soar across procedurally generated biomes! 🌎

🛠️ Build your dream plane using blocks from the shop!
💥 Survive wild obstacles and explore amazing biomes!
🚀 Launch and earn cash to upgrade your build every flight!
⚡ Get rare and unique blocks, each with its very own mutations!

⏰ Remember, your plane literally flies offline! 🤑
